events.comment: GDevelop Open Game - 3D city sandbox. Walk around, steal cars (E), and collect all the cash. Assets: Kenney (CC0).

inlineCode: // The sky box also lights the scene (image based lighting), which washes out the colors.
// Keep it as the background only: the "Sky" and "Sun" lights of the layer light the city.
// Pointer lock mouse look: click the game to capture the mouse, Esc to release.

events.comment: Only one car can be driven at a time: the one whose "Driven" variable is true.
Swing the camera behind the car while it moves.
Leave the car: the player is recreated next to the driver door.
Enter the nearest building or car.

Standing next to a house or shop (inside its invisible DoorZone, which covers the building plus a margin) lets you enter. Each building always opens the same interior: its Layout and HouseId are set on the DoorZone instance.
Blasters: walk over one to pick it up (it swaps with the one you hold). Hold the left mouse button to shoot.
Pick up the nearest blaster; the one in hand is dropped where the new one was.
Aiming: while shooting the player faces the camera direction and strafes with WASD. No shooting while running (Shift).
Over-the-shoulder camera while armed, so the blaster isn't hidden behind the head.

inlineCode: // Keep the held blaster in the player's right hand (the "arm-right" bone of the Kenney character)
// and remember the muzzle position for the shooting events.
// GunOut tells the shooting events (next frame) that the blaster is in hand and the muzzle is up to date.
// The blaster is only in hand when standing still or aiming: walking (or driving) puts it away.
x = hand.x; y = hand.y; z = hand.z;

events.comment: HUD: weapon icon of the held blaster (its animation has the weapon's name).
Third-person orbit camera around Target (the player or the driven car).

Traffic drives along the lanes, turns at the crossings and stops at red lights, for people and for other cars. Pedestrians walk around the blocks, cross at the lights and run away from gunshots. Cars the player leaves stay parked until the player is gone.
